Name: The Love of Cooking
Author: bblueberry
Description:
[size=4][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/h6qYbPK.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/f41mZZc.png[/img]

[b]﻿﻿[color=#7f5de3]1.[/color][/b] Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url],
[b]﻿[color=#7f5de3]2.[/color][/b] Add the [b]Love of Cooking[/b] to your [b]Mods[/b] folder along with all dependencies,
[b]﻿[color=#7f5de3]3.[/color][/b] Ensure [b]all players in multiplayer[/b] have this mod installed!

[b][color=#7f5de3]﻿+[/color][/b] [b]All features are optional[/b] and can be enabled or disabled via the config menu.
[b][color=#7f5de3]﻿+[/color][/b] To change features in-game, use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
[b][color=#7f5de3]﻿+[/color][/b] To uninstall this mod, simply remove it from your Mods folder.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/jgeApTN.png[/img]

Update the [img]https://i.imgur.com/kxPrkWa.png[/img] [b]Cooking Menu[/b] with a new look!
Find and filter for foods on the left page, and add your ingredients on the right page.
Choose the right ingredients, set the amount to make, and click the [img]https://i.imgur.com/GOr5dPV.png[/img] Frying Pan to cook!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kxPrkWa.png[/img] Mom's Cookbook and [img]https://i.imgur.com/vpahtCx.png[/img] Frying Pan will arrive by mail after a couple weeks..
.. or whenever you get a kitchen, whichever comes first.
They'll be added to your [b][color=#7f5de3]✮[/color] Special Powers [/b]tab when received.

Use the [b]Backpack/Fridge [/b]inventory button to pick your ingredients.
Use the [b]Auto-fill Ingredients [/b]inventory button to cook with convenience.

[b][color=#7f5de3]﻿+ [/color][/b]Comes with full gamepad usability, controls visible in the config menu.
[b][color=#7f5de3]﻿+ [/color][/b]Keyboard users can change recipes, inventories, and cooking quantities by scrolling the mousewheel.
[b][color=#7f5de3]﻿x [/color][/b]Cooking animations can be disabled in the config menu.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/dTGhEde.png[/img]


Level up with the new [img]https://i.imgur.com/OsA1is2.png[/img] [b]Cooking Skill and Recipes[/b] whenever you make food!
Earn more experience by cooking each day, rather than in bulk.
Modest XP bonuses are given for crafting new and complicated recipes.
Professions improve results when cooking, eating, and gifting food.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/peLF2Oi.png[/img]

Cook 35 delicious recipes learned with each new level!
Clear out the fridge with a few tasty recipes that put a twist on some less-used ingredients.

Some new cooking recipes include unique buffs:

[spoiler]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/C6NE67F.png[/img] [b]Braised Leeks [/b]— Leek Me Alone!
Increases the knockback of all weapons.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/h6QGRwH.png[/img] [b]Profiteroles [/b]— Proliferate Projectiles
Triples the output of all slingshots.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lpwCMR8.png[/img] [b]Kebab [/b]— Drunken Brawler
Increases combat strength with every drink when Tipsy.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/f23cTaA.png[/img] [b]Lasagna Ricotta [/b]— Fullness Aura
Forces nearby enemies to walk more slowly.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YhsLuKS.png[/img] [b]Curry Diablo [/b]— Curry Breath
Breathe fire when eaten, burning enemies in front of you.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/eUVwUMQ.png[/img] [b]Paella [/b]— Saffron Stash
Enemies scatter gold coins when slain.
[/spoiler]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/OsA1is2.png[/img] Requires the [b]Cooking Skill and Recipes[/b].


[img]https://i.imgur.com/uRkbf0S.png[/img]
﻿ ﻿  
Add tool progression to the [img]https://i.imgur.com/kxPrkWa.png[/img] [b]Cooking Menu[/b]!
When enabled, you can only cook with a limited number of ingredients at a time.
Upgrade your [img]https://i.imgur.com/vpahtCx.png[/img] [b]Frying Pan[/b] from Clint's shop to increase the number of ingredients you can use.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kxPrkWa.png[/img] Requires the [b]Cooking Menu[/b].


[img]https://i.imgur.com/L21urmf.png[/img]

Unlock more [b]seasoning items[/b] by mail when reaching cooking milestones!
Improves the quality of a dish by a little, depending on the seasoning.
Used automatically when cooking, can be toggled with the [img]https://i.imgur.com/hjG7LN6.png[/img] [b]Cooking Menu[/b].

[spoiler]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/vy01DjQ.png[/img] [b]Simple Seasoning[/b]
Earn the Cook achievement.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xge0sLL.png[/img] [b]Super Seasoning[/b]
Earn the Sous Chef achievement.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jcqBTTt.png[/img] [b]Qi Seasoning[/b]
Complete Qi's Challenge.
[/spoiler]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XeRNecx.png[/img]


[size=5][b]town kitchens[/b][/size]

Cook food for your friends in the village!
Kitchens are usable anywhere in town, so long as you're friends with whoever lives there.
Check the config menu to see who's available.

[size=5][b]food heals over time[/b][/size]

Food heals gradually instead of instantly.
Get the most of your Farming and Combat buffs by eating before you lose HP/EP.
Healing is applied far more slowly when at full HP, and far more quickly at low HP.
Restoration speed improves with Combat, Farming, and Cooking levels.
Life Elixir and Energy Tonic will always heal instantly.
[b][color=#7f5de3]﻿x [/color]Disabled by default[/b].

[size=5][b]food buffs start hidden[/b][/size]

All foods will have their buff effects hidden until you've eaten them.
Buffs will be visible on all items of that kind afterward.
Health and energy restoration remains visible.
[b][color=#7f5de3]﻿x [/color]Disabled by default[/b].

[size=5][b]food can burn[/b][/size]

Ruin your food! Waste your time!
Adds a chance for your food to turn into burnt trash.
[b][color=#7f5de3]﻿x [/color]Disabled by default[/b]. You really shouldn't turn this on.
